spend_lanes.why: Join against the wagering corpus yields no defensible brand totals (US census carries 1 wagering-brand ad; UK archive carries audience bands, not spend). Modelled band points exist per creative in the study bank but are not displayed as spend.

methods: Trends index values are 0-100 within each API window (rescaled per call); the live help-seeking index is anchor-normalized to 'gambling addiction' so the 116 paper queries can be summed comparably to Study 1's Trends Sum. Spend lanes are never summed with each other or with Study 1.
